title: Network Inspector rule scenarios
description: Named sets of shared rules turned on together, in Android Studio (Scenario dropdown) and in the Appium mocks (--es scenario "name").

name.description: Unique. Used as --es scenario "name" in Appium tests.

enable.description: Rules to turn on; every other shared rule is turned off. Each item is a team, team/file.json, [team] rule name, or *.

variables.description: Variable values while the scenario is on. Committed to git: never emails, passwords or tokens. A developer's own value still wins.
